items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: that’s how I got to see Nat Cole with my parents. They took me to see him at the Flamingo.

ctx.x: He had the little Italian mouse, you see how? Yeah, who could forget this. Senor Wences — a different guy, but he had yeah this thing. Boy that left an impact. And my parents took — they were very interested in Las Vegas, hearing about it, all, so many of these performers on television and on the talk shows Johnny Carson was our only talk show host at that time. We finally got cable TV from Duluth, Minnesota and were able to see Johnny Carson. And then, you know, Las Vegas, everybody seemed to be talking about it…

went to but dinner shows, they had something they called the dinner show at that time and if there was anything risque about you know this show, a dinner show would be much milder in comparison. Kids were allowed to go because they served dinner — a technicality — and that’s how I got to see Nat Cole with my parents. They took me to see him at the Flamingo. I’ll never forget it.
Why? It’s an obvious question because of his musicianship, but I’m wondering if there was something beyond that that also caught your attention?
